entries.title: SO-101 Arm
entries.body: Kicking off the SO-101 Arm build: a small PPO policy trained on domain-randomized MuJoCo-Warp sims of the SO-101 (BAM STS3215 actuator model), exported to ONNX, and deployed onto the real arm's STS3215 servos via rustypot on a Jetson Orin Nano. Started today — each pipeline stage is tracked as its own piece.
